Healthcare professionals generally advise  [Highlight start] **avoiding alcohol while taking Sudafed** (pseudoephedrine) or Sudafed PE (phenylephrine) [Highlight end] , even though there is no strict official contraindication for plain pseudoephedrine alone.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXZtgDtOq4kmUm5RWZKI9iAuY-_f_9dnDEY2yB97jaHkxU1_77czqOvOCyI3tLjgbfiNk9UTIuoPAqaDVGSKEZfCufmzzvinPi6EXsrqaxoz2ocTGAHZULpagzYwVPw00kBS9kzE8j1UJUsA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1752GcQdJ58ZvrkHGePQGEchlXV_8PnLTUUu1fyGhJgPf42BdCTcDfxXyXHI2WEkyviuoXbTXRI-GwDl3CyYAW064wmYw6bbHkU1kfbH9wrZISy2lqR38MsuxDpjCVGPYVt0s3VQJHn_w0FzlOrpZ3JuUFblmQoMHdyN2bjZ-20SFiOCEQZJ1w4XrQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXU5yM5yHX3L08ukFiXkoGPFeb2BwmOY-7HZaJkFA4TsTiZtFaNGPD3vW-JO6z8xaT6ACXGRmarj8lDGZ2NJ86l6B8ehybfhz1wh3O9GSR4GlyJeqv04xa7f3kGTrqwSIZQbAq)

### Main Risks of Mixing Them

- **Worsened side effects:** Both substances can trigger dizziness, headache, nausea, anxiety, and changes in heart rate or blood pressure.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1752GcQdJ58ZvrkHGePQGEchlXV_8PnLTUUu1fyGhJgPf42BdCTcDfxXyXHI2WEkyviuoXbTXRI-GwDl3CyYAW064wmYw6bbHkU1kfbH9wrZISy2lqR38MsuxDpjCVGPYVt0s3VQJHn_w0FzlOrpZ3JuUFblmQoMHdyN2bjZ-20SFiOCEQZJ1w4XrQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXZtgDtOq4kmUm5RWZKI9iAuY-_f_9dnDEY2yB97jaHkxU1_77czqOvOCyI3tLjgbfiNk9UTIuoPAqaDVGSKEZfCufmzzvinPi6EXsrqaxoz2ocTGAHZULpagzYwVPw00kBS9kzE8j1UJUsA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF1_n5fwSPh2Y_4fjaAGfIOoGjDDvpOSE5IL1tKBPq0mFlpDbBqQtwtn6QNusXFpb1PYqHlL9yB5fUl4kGb44CWcGxA81j00jysfglKDkmm0xeME4bPGQH_lxsZsa9fUkOJCXLL3aPPflX_B4HKqS3AHC6L-jd30zFjveozA)
- **Masked intoxication:** Because Sudafed acts as a stimulant and alcohol is a depressant, Sudafed can hide how impaired you feel. This can lead to drinking more than intended and increasing injury risk.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13kXkh4Fk9-qFx--o_k3qtsWTD5yGKgC7ASuX-HGWluBalBeSWcDuiWaI8HzKlYJ1KmChtR9X4sjx9Wbu6Sku5xohM-SE7cLV_AP-Q_lfzrqkdM48oZT6YXTGsyoxw-XTzRdmVEe8VgwivBnVT9mx5TLKFWA-m3DyBqY1A)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF11skm27iYv8Xz4KZXjmIVpzSkaF8RwqmJ0eYPPQQYC9f1Eh1KnrayFqjkz9TJPB5s8zrkUUtMCwIpMMzVm-iz_BmLqq7FDrDZwB3fGOVavn8CrqNoT2HvUR8PMXMT1KE9pG9DBS8KHS0-myTx-XcTwysv-5osnf6ZktulaXPSxP5JWTbc-bYGYEpDk_zP5DCpa98e3Y)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXZtgDtOq4kmUm5RWZKI9iAuY-_f_9dnDEY2yB97jaHkxU1_77czqOvOCyI3tLjgbfiNk9UTIuoPAqaDVGSKEZfCufmzzvinPi6EXsrqaxoz2ocTGAHZULpagzYwVPw00kBS9kzE8j1UJUsA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1752GcQdJ58ZvrkHGePQGEchlXV_8PnLTUUu1fyGhJgPf42BdCTcDfxXyXHI2WEkyviuoXbTXRI-GwDl3CyYAW064wmYw6bbHkU1kfbH9wrZISy2lqR38MsuxDpjCVGPYVt0s3VQJHn_w0FzlOrpZ3JuUFblmQoMHdyN2bjZ-20SFiOCEQZJ1w4XrQ)
- **Slower recovery and worse congestion:** Alcohol can weaken your immune response when you are sick, and certain drinks with histamines can worsen nasal congestion if allergies are involved.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1752GcQdJ58ZvrkHGePQGEchlXV_8PnLTUUu1fyGhJgPf42BdCTcDfxXyXHI2WEkyviuoXbTXRI-GwDl3CyYAW064wmYw6bbHkU1kfbH9wrZISy2lqR38MsuxDpjCVGPYVt0s3VQJHn_w0FzlOrpZ3JuUFblmQoMHdyN2bjZ-20SFiOCEQZJ1w4XrQ)
- **Extra dangers in combo products:** Many multi-symptom cold and sinus formulas combine decongestants with pain relievers (like acetaminophen or ibuprofen) or antihistamines. Mixing those with alcohol raises risks like liver strain, stomach bleeding, or heavy sedation.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXZtgDtOq4kmUm5RWZKI9iAuY-_f_9dnDEY2yB97jaHkxU1_77czqOvOCyI3tLjgbfiNk9UTIuoPAqaDVGSKEZfCufmzzvinPi6EXsrqaxoz2ocTGAHZULpagzYwVPw00kBS9kzE8j1UJUsA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1_zUFttp3yC7FOzSEEV0bxsHT4XrKECIWGJwyf_4YTT83N2MGhn7245Hm6O2noRpG6BGyTIjHKdtEycgNiViXOkMLEmeDHiJ3B3u5p4_GZjdf7wRix2FcVjzrOsC41e1iCfix9lMXi6t3oapDZKzVpXvK7EHH_FbgmGkpj35lBMsOdqe)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXXc9MlvIyuHcGrhDNzeLhY0sH75i3AkZDboBxh7N1lF1FAu5UsFVvhVR2PLtx7WwDpWiLo3uO5ReV5AHkwbMnkuKRMWwytrz7ckguDdK4C-lEIjggchxqFckcAyaQ6gLR7lOJdRc8)

### Practical Guidance

- **Wait until the medication clears:** If you plan to drink, many clinicians suggest stopping the decongestant and waiting at least **24 hours** after your last dose (or longer for extended-release formulas).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScQHEIkXXbzcaAlLx4ONqU0gZsXBTGCnMGnvxZ4SVsU5dD9jFI8IUvYX75kKOeQxw-OS7KYZNVlfhAQeDy-ZDLpp1-CwcJSQ5d6m53TU6bAL92J6HYvvqZ0TbvR3b10GrlEzmzJW3YzEyJ3Vpf54T6WG-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1752GcQdJ58ZvrkHGePQGEchlXV_8PnLTUUu1fyGhJgPf42BdCTcDfxXyXHI2WEkyviuoXbTXRI-GwDl3CyYAW064wmYw6bbHkU1kfbH9wrZISy2lqR38MsuxDpjCVGPYVt0s3VQJHn_w0FzlOrpZ3JuUFblmQoMHdyN2bjZ-20SFiOCEQZJ1w4XrQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF13kXkh4Fk9-qFx--o_k3qtsWTD5yGKgC7ASuX-HGWluBalBeSWcDuiWaI8HzKlYJ1KmChtR9X4sjx9Wbu6Sku5xohM-SE7cLV_AP-Q_lfzrqkdM48oZT6YXTGsyoxw-XTzRdmVEe8VgwivBnVT9mx5TLKFWA-m3DyBqY1A)
- **Check the active ingredients:** Read the label carefully to see if you are taking plain Sudafed or a multi-symptom combination product.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXZtgDtOq4kmUm5RWZKI9iAuY-_f_9dnDEY2yB97jaHkxU1_77czqOvOCyI3tLjgbfiNk9UTIuoPAqaDVGSKEZfCufmzzvinPi6EXsrqaxoz2ocTGAHZULpagzYwVPw00kBS9kzE8j1UJUsA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1_zUFttp3yC7FOzSEEV0bxsHT4XrKECIWGJwyf_4YTT83N2MGhn7245Hm6O2noRpG6BGyTIjHKdtEycgNiViXOkMLEmeDHiJ3B3u5p4_GZjdf7wRix2FcVjzrOsC41e1iCfix9lMXi6t3oapDZKzVpXvK7EHH_FbgmGkpj35lBMsOdqe)

For more details on avoiding common decongestant pitfalls, see [GoodRx](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1752GcQdJ58ZvrkHGePQGEchlXV_8PnLTUUu1fyGhJgPf42BdCTcDfxXyXHI2WEkyviuoXbTXRI-GwDl3CyYAW064wmYw6bbHkU1kfbH9wrZISy2lqR38MsuxDpjCVGPYVt0s3VQJHn_w0FzlOrpZ3JuUFblmQoMHdyN2bjZ-20SFiOCEQZJ1w4XrQ) or [SingleCare](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXZtgDtOq4kmUm5RWZKI9iAuY-_f_9dnDEY2yB97jaHkxU1_77czqOvOCyI3tLjgbfiNk9UTIuoPAqaDVGSKEZfCufmzzvinPi6EXsrqaxoz2ocTGAHZULpagzYwVPw00kBS9kzE8j1UJUsA) . You can also review general guidance on [Pseudoephedrine](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXU5yM5yHX3L08ukFiXkoGPFeb2BwmOY-7HZaJkFA4TsTiZtFaNGPD3vW-JO6z8xaT6ACXGRmarj8lDGZ2NJ86l6B8ehybfhz1wh3O9GSR4GlyJeqv04xa7f3kGTrqwSIZQbAq) from the NHS.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaAHEIkXXU5yM5yHX3L08ukFiXkoGPFeb2BwmOY-7HZaJkFA4TsTiZtFaNGPD3vW-JO6z8xaT6ACXGRmarj8lDGZ2NJ86l6B8ehybfhz1wh3O9GSR4GlyJeqv04xa7f3kGTrqwSIZQbAq)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESjwEBxCJF1752GcQdJ58ZvrkHGePQGEchlXV_8PnLTUUu1fyGhJgPf42BdCTcDfxXyXHI2WEkyviuoXbTXRI-GwDl3CyYAW064wmYw6bbHkU1kfbH9wrZISy2lqR38MsuxDpjCVGPYVt0s3VQJHn_w0FzlOrpZ3JuUFblmQoMHdyN2bjZ-20SFiOCEQZJ1w4XrQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbwHEIkXXZtgDtOq4kmUm5RWZKI9iAuY-_f_9dnDEY2yB97jaHkxU1_77czqOvOCyI3tLjgbfiNk9UTIuoPAqaDVGSKEZfCufmzzvinPi6EXsrqaxoz2ocTGAHZULpagzYwVPw00kBS9kzE8j1UJUsA)To tailor this information, let me know if you want to explore:
